findings.message: Codex review of TASK-050 confirms all acceptance criteria are met. MVP E2E acceptance suite implementation is complete with comprehensive scenario coverage.

Deterministic MVP end-to-end acceptance suite covers all critical user workflows: kid create, play, AI assist, publish, and parent approval. This provides comprehensive validation of the core game experience.
Safety refusal and rollback behavior are validated in both kid and parent paths, confirming that safety mechanisms correctly protect users in all scenarios.
Machine-readable output via MVP_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT_JSON enables automated CI processing and reporting, facilitating integration into deployment pipelines.
CI runner script properly integrated into quality gates, ensuring MVP acceptance validation is part of the standard pre-merge and pre-release checks.
All validation passes: run-mvp-acceptance-suite.sh (exit 0) and run-quality-gates.sh (exit 0). Scenario completeness and acceptance semantics have been verified.
Review request documentation confirms scenario completeness and acceptance semantics are appropriate for release. All acceptance criteria mapping verified.

summary: APPROVE. TASK-050 implementation and codex review are both complete and correct. MVP E2E acceptance suite with machine-readable output is fully operational and integrated into CI. All acceptance criteria are met: all critical workflows covered, safety mechanisms validated, output executable and reported. Scenario completeness and acceptance semantics verified. The copilot cross review confirms all findings and validates the implementation.
